text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn in ways that are similar to humans. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve difficult problems. Today, AI is used in many parts of daily life. For example, it helps with voice assistants, movie recommendations, online shopping, and even medical tests. AI is changing the world quickly and making many tasks easier.
